title: REGIME SWITCH
style: Vibe: More mechanical groove, lots of vocoder counter‑rhythms, focused on regime detection and macro shifts.
lyrics:
[Intro – robotic]
Regime: neutral.
Volatility: contained.
Awaiting transition…

[Verse 1 – male]
The chain doesn’t shout when the tide turns slow,
It just tweaks distributions in a quiet flow.
Supply aging out of exchanges, calm,
Volatility compressing like a ticking bomb.
He plots the moments when risk gets tight,
When one small spark can ignite the night.
Not a crystal ball, just a pressure gauge,
Mapping where trend flips page by page.

[Hook – staccato, group]
Bear or bull, it’s a regime switch,
Not one wick making someone rich.
Watch the flows, the holders’ bind,
See the regime shift with On-Chain Mind.

[Verse 2 – male]
From bottom clusters to blow-off tops,
He tracks how conviction builds and drops.
Momentum tools that don’t chase the spike,
They frame the path, the context you like.
“No hype, no guesswork,” that’s the code,
Just charts and clarity for the heavy load.
If you want to surf instead of stand blind,
Study the regimes he carefully designed.

[Bridge – spoken, over stripped beat]
The label “bull” or “bear”
is just a name.
What matters
is the environment you’re in.

[Final Hook – repeat with extra vocoder harmonies]
Bear or bull, it’s a regime switch,
Not one wick making someone rich.
Watch the flows, the holders’ bind,
See the regime shift with On-Chain Mind.
